title: The Doctrine as Fixed Point: Endogenous Penalty Enforcement, Multiplicity, and the Irreversibility of Capital Shocks in Markets for Expert Services
abstract: arXiv:2609.26264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In markets for expert services under improving AI, separation through an outcome-contingent liability commitment survives only if the enforceable multiple of actual loss, $m$, is large enough. That literature, including our own, treats $m$ as a legal datum. It is not. Post-Cavendish the enforceable multiple is measured against the legitimate interest the clause protects; where that interest is the preservation of human fallback capability, the interest exists only if the commitment separates, which requires a large enough $m$. We close the loop and study the resulting doctrine map $m' = D(m)$. Six results follow. First, $D$ is monotone on a complete lattice, so a fixed point exists, and it is unique unless the maximal doctrinal uplift exceeds four times the dispersion of the case-level threshold; when multiplicity obtains there are generically three fixed points, of which the outer two are stable. translated_title: 作为不动点的法律原则：专家服务市场中的内生惩罚条款执行、多重性与资本冲击的不可逆性
translated_abstract: 在人工智能不断进步的专家服务市场中，依靠以结果为条件的责任承诺来实现分离，只有当可执行的实际损失倍数 $m$ 足够大时才能维持。包括我们自己在内的相关文献都把 $m$ 视为法律上给定的数据，但它并非如此。在Cavendish案之后，可执行的倍数是相对于该条款所保护的合法利益来衡量的；而当这一利益是人类后备能力的保全时，只有当该承诺能够实现分离时这一利益才存在，而分离又要求足够大的 $m$。我们闭合了这一循环，并研究所得到的原则映射 $m' = D(m)$。由此得出六个结果。第一，$D$ 在完备格上单调，因此不动点存在；除非最大的法理提升幅度超过案件层面阈值离散度的四倍，否则不动点唯一；当出现多重性时，一般存在三个不动点，其中外侧两个是稳定的。第二，基于主要法律来源的校准……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次将专家服务市场中可执行的惩罚倍数内生化，把法律原则刻画为自指映射 m'=D(m) 的不动点，证明不动点存在且通常唯一（出现多重性时一般为三个且外侧两个稳定），并由此揭示专家服务市场中资本冲击的不可逆性。
en_tdlr: The paper endogenizes the enforceable penalty multiple in markets for expert services by modeling legal doctrine as a fixed point of the self-referential map m'=D(m), proving existence and generic uniqueness (with generically three fixed points, the outer two stable, when multiplicity arises) and deriving the irreversibility of capital shocks.
